stem: Which photo set provides the strongest observation evidence?
choices: A filtered close-up with no identity
A context image and clear close image linked to plant or zone identity and time
A cropped image saved without location
An edited image that exaggerates color difference
rationale: A context image and clear close image linked to plant or zone identity and time. This response preserves the Course 002 evidence, identity, role-boundary or documentation principle being assessed.
